status: frozen before this analyst inspected follow-up control outcomes; not external preregistration
forecast_target: For EACH follow-up matched measurement window, median of paired established DoH elapsed_ms minus fresh UDP elapsed_ms INCLUDING explicit socket creation and bind setup will be greater than zero. Exact labels: doh_warm minus udp_fresh.
implementation_caveat: The follow-up fresh UDP explicitly binds inside elapsed_ms; the historical client uses implicit bind. This is a prospective sign transport check under an implementation change, not exact validation of an identical estimator or a pure network/cryptography estimate.
evaluation: Use every completed planned window and complete successful matched pairs; retain failures, missingness, zero medians and opposite signs. No adaptive window selection, retuning or p-value. Positive median matches; zero/negative does not.
secondary_contrasts: udp_fresh minus udp_bound: whole elapsed_ms includes lifecycle setup only for fresh
udp_fresh minus udp_bound: common transport_elapsed_ms from send-call to response receipt, after bind; validation excluded
doh_warm minus udp_bound: elapsed_ms client-and-service composite; setup excluded by pre-established clients
inference_boundaries: No population confidence guarantee; selected windows may share serial conditions. Persistent source ports may alter network or cache affinity. Do not assign every UDP difference to local CPU/socket overhead. Do not pool dates/control estimator as a universal penalty.
